title: SciReasoner: Native Structural Reasoning Across Proteins, Molecules, and Crystals
hook: Most scientific AI predicts an answer without showing its structural work. SciReasoner turns 3D structure itself into evidence tokens the model reasons over — and hits SOTA on 67 of 86 benchmarks.
key_points: Discretizes protein, molecule, and crystal structure (coordinates, topology, periodic connectivity) into one shared 'structure-aware' vocabulary.
Treats these structural tokens as addressable evidence during reasoning, not just opaque input features.
State-of-the-art on 67 of 86 benchmarks spanning biology, chemistry, and materials science.
Raises single-step retrosynthesis accuracy from 0.63 to 0.72 while generating inspectable disconnection/precursor-verification traces.
Improves protein function prediction (Gene Ontology F_max) from 0.42 to 0.55 on low-homology, orphan-like proteins.
Double-blind expert review rated its reasoning traces preferred or comparable to a frontier LLM's in 98% of cases.
content_html: Most models that predict a protein's function or a molecule's reaction pathway treat 3D structure as a black-box input — useful for the final number, invisible in the reasoning. SciReasoner, a multimodal scientific foundation model, instead turns structure into evidence it can point to.
extra_html:
Built by a large multi-institution team (Shanghai AI Lab and collaborators), SciReasoner discretizes coordinates, bonding topology, and periodic crystal connectivity into a single structure-aware vocabulary shared across proteins, small molecules, and inorganic crystals. That lets the model treat structural tokens as addressable evidence units — citing which piece of geometry justifies which conclusion — rather than compressing structure into an uninterpretable feature vector. Across 86 benchmarks spanning biology, chemistry, and materials science, the authors report state-of-the-art results on 67, including large jumps on protein function prediction for hard, low-homology cases and on single-step retrosynthesis, where the model also emits inspectable disconnection and precursor-verification traces.

The headline claim isn't just accuracy: a double-blind expert evaluation found SciReasoner's reasoning traces preferred or comparable to a frontier general-purpose LLM's in 98% of cases, suggesting structure-native models can produce scientifically legible explanations, not just correct answers.

related.title: AlphaFold: Protein Structure Prediction
related.hook: Predicting a protein's 3D shape from its sequence stumped biology for ~50 years. AlphaFold cracked it at near-experimental accuracy — and then released the structures to everyone.

related.title: AlphaFold 3: Predicting Biomolecular Interactions
related.hook: AlphaFold 3 extends protein structure prediction to full biomolecular complexes - proteins with DNA, RNA, ligands, and ions - using a diffusion-based architecture.

related.title: GraphCast: Skillful Medium-Range Weather Forecasting
related.hook: A graph neural network predicts 10-day global weather in under a minute on one machine, matching or beating physics-based forecast models on most variables.
